description: This file defines Kubernetes API types related to flow control, including FlowSchema and PriorityLevelConfiguration, with associated constants, types, and documentation.

classes.name: FlowSchema
classes.description: Defines a schema for grouping API requests with similar attributes, including metadata, spec, and status.

classes.name: FlowSchemaSpec
classes.description: Specifies how a FlowSchema matches requests, including priority, rules, and distinguisher method.

classes.name: FlowSchemaStatus
classes.description: Represents the current state of a FlowSchema, including conditions.

classes.name: FlowSchemaCondition
classes.description: Describes a specific condition of a FlowSchema, such as dangling status.

classes.name: PriorityLevelConfiguration
classes.description: Defines configuration for request priority levels, including spec and status.

classes.name: PriorityLevelConfigurationSpec
classes.description: Specifies whether a priority level is exempt or limited, and related configurations.

classes.name: LimitedPriorityLevelConfiguration
classes.description: Details on how to handle requests for limited priority levels, including concurrency and borrowing limits.

classes.name: ExemptPriorityLevelConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration for exempt priority levels, mainly concurrency shares and lendable percent.

classes.name: LimitResponse
classes.description: Defines how to handle requests that cannot be immediately executed, either queue or reject.

classes.name: QueuingConfiguration
classes.description: Parameters for request queuing, including number of queues, hand size, and queue length limit.

classes.name: PriorityLevelConfigurationCondition
classes.description: Represents the condition/status of a priority level configuration.

classes.name: FlowDistinguisherMethod
classes.description: Specifies how to compute flow distinguishers, either by user or namespace.

classes.name: FlowDistinguisherMethodType
classes.description: Enumeration of flow distinguisher types: ByUser, ByNamespace.

classes.name: FlowSchemaCondition
classes.description: Condition details for a FlowSchema, including type, status, reason, and message.

classes.name: FlowSchemaConditionType
classes.description: Types of conditions for FlowSchema, e.g., dangling.
